runs.label: Runpod private UDP · 3 Pods / full mesh
runs.scope: Raw private IPv4 UDP echo RTT; 18,000 request/echo roundtrips across six ordered Pod pairs
runs.model: LOW_RATE_FIXED_ARRIVAL; 200 requests/s on one tested path at a time; authenticated UDP echo
runs.durability: None; UDP echo has no journal, quorum or persistent business state
limitations: Network reachability/source/payload checks only; these samples are not business commands, matching latency or a capacity benchmark.
Three EU-RO-1 Pods with distinct Pod identities and kernel boot IDs; provider self-GET returned 403, machineId was unavailable, and physical anti-affinity is not certified.
Each ordered pair sent 3,000 requests: 1,000 each at 96, 512 and 1248 payload bytes, all with IPv4 DF. Largest tested IP datagram was 1276 bytes on a 1300-MTU private interface.
18,000 unique returned echoes; zero observed loss, duplicates or reordering. Finite low-rate observations do not guarantee future zero loss.
Pooled nearest-rank RTT includes every returned sample: p99.9 9.909679 ms; max 39.338844 ms. No cold-tail samples were removed; no one-way latency was measured.
Global Networking is specified at 100 Mbps by the provider; bandwidth saturation was not measured.

runs.label: Runpod replicated matching · 3 Pods / 1 client
runs.scope: Client execute RTT: encoding, private UDP transport, quorum commit, matching, response and automatic retries
runs.model: CLOSED_LOOP_SINGLE_INFLIGHT; maximum one logical request in flight
runs.durability: 3 Pods; Archive/catalog/consensus sync level 2; temporary container overlay disks
limitations: 900 measured accepted commands, 300 trades and 1,200 executed lots; two deposits and 90 warmup commands are excluded from measurement.
Single-inflight closed-loop smoke, not open-loop saturation or a capacity result. Throughput elapsed time includes reference matching, validation and sample recording.
Load generator shares node 2 with a cluster member; this is not an independent fourth load-generation host.
Measured execute RTT max 526.493987 ms; p99.9 equals this maximum with only 900 samples. 2 accepted automatic resends and 3 unaccepted offers were retained; zero unknown request timeouts.
Same running Pods and temporary disks; sync level 2 does not establish persistence after Pod stop/rebuild or host power loss. Physical anti-affinity was not provider-certified.
This card verifies normal matching, canonical state bytes, invariants and same-key replay. External recovery and PostgreSQL projection results require separate evidence.

runs.label: Runpod recovery · leader kill & cold restart
runs.scope: Two successful leader SIGKILL rounds after bootstrap repair; snapshot, all-JVM stop/start and canonical state verification
runs.model: EXTERNAL_PROCESS_FAULTS; same running Pods and mounted ephemeral filesystems
runs.durability: Sync level 2; replicated core and 1,574 pending outbox events restored
limitations: Campaign preserved one initial bootstrap timeout and one launcher identity failure; repairs preceded the successful repeat.
Two successful orchestration intervals were 28.451 and 31.386 seconds, including SSH/JVM/checks; pure election and first-new-write latency were not measured.
Same core hash at command 1,182; all three members restored snapshot and caught up. This command count includes setup and warmup.
No Pod-stop, physical power-loss, AZ-loss or persistent-volume recovery proof; physical anti-affinity is unverified.

runs.label: Runpod end to end · quorum through PostgreSQL
runs.scope: HTTP -> Aeron quorum -> gateway mirror -> asynchronous PostgreSQL cursor observation | Caller-supplied layout: Runpod EU-RO-1 three-Pod private UDP cluster; gateway/database share member 2; cluster members=3; gatewaySharesClusterMember=true; postgresSharesClusterMember=true
runs.model: FUNCTIONAL_SMOKE; HTTP place / retry / conflict / cancel / mirror replay / database cursor
runs.durability: Aeron quorum and asynchronous PostgreSQL 18.6; fsync and synchronous_commit enabled
limitations: Functional verification, not a latency or capacity benchmark. Gateway and PostgreSQL share member 2.
Before gateway startup, restored outbox plus post-cold business projected 2,896 events and 722 trades with observed lag 0.
HTTP verification reached confirmed event/cursor 3,300 and 819 cumulative trades after separate synthetic market flow; the two HTTP commands themselves made zero trades.
Database cursor is a cached observation. PostgreSQL is one instance on an ephemeral disk; PostgreSQL HA and Pod-stop recovery were not tested.
Initial HTTP attempt preceded gateway readiness and failed before sending business commands; successful follow-up trace is retained.

One 900-command single-inflight trial; 2 setup and 90 warmup commands excluded. This is not a capacity or open-loop result.

Control and patched runs used different leaders (2 and 0), took place at different times and started with different retained-state sizes. Do not attribute throughput or median changes solely to the patch.

The patch makes at most three response offers, only for ADMIN_ACTION; other failures still use same-key client recovery. Server response-offer retry counts are not instrumented by the client resend counter.
Canonical bytes, per-command results/sequences, invariants and same-key replay passed; reference uses the same MatchingEngine implementation.
Shared load host, unverified physical anti-affinity and no Pod-stop or power-loss durability guarantee.
